title: WPA band outside jobs, pay and hours
summary: The WPA musicians could take outside jobs; Decatur Street work paid decently in the Depression and ran late into the night.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Were you allowed to take outside jobs in that WPA band, or was that part of the, uh, project?
Yeah. We used to take outside jobs. We used to play outside jobs.
How did they pay in those days down there?
Down the corner. Down the corner of the night. That was plenty of money in that time. We were doing the depression. Uh-huh.
What hours did you have to work?
I mean, down there on Decatur?
